value.title: HTML script defer Attribute - W3Schools
value.snippet: Definition and Usage The defer attribute is a boolean attribute . If the defer attribute is set, it specifies that the script is downloaded in parallel to parsing the page, and executed after the page has finished parsing. Note: The defer attribute is only for external scripts (should only be used if the src attribute is present).
